units.rawText: Another busy day is over. I'm so tired... What are you so surprised about, Professor?
units.displayText: Another busy day is over. I'm so tired... What are you so surprised about, Professor?

units.rawText: Even a workaholic like yours truly gets tired sometimes. It would be nice to have a snug, comfy human chair right about now. Huh?! You'll let me sit on you and rest, Professor?

units.rawText: Ugh... How could yours truly... Oh, right. Chairs don't talk, so you'll need to stay quiet. Once yours truly's body and mind have relaxed, you'll be released from this "chair role-play." Phew... phew...
